name: hyper-text

frames.best_why: The letters are mid-scramble, flickering random capitals while the first word already resolves.

tagline: Random capitals flicker and settle into the real words on hover.
summary: A line of bold monospace text that briefly breaks into random uppercase letters and then locks in letter by letter from left to right, like a decoder resolving a message.
appearance: A single line of large, heavy uppercase monospace letters in white on black. During the effect the same letter shapes remain but many characters are replaced by unrelated capitals.
behaviour: On hover the text scrambles, then settles from the left as a moving front sweeps right, with each character flipping through random letters until the true sentence is restored. It also plays once shortly after appearing.
use_when: A short heading should feel decoded, glitchy or futuristic when hovered.
avoid_when: Touch screens or long copy; there is no hover to trigger it and the scramble hurts reading.
customise: Pass the text as children and set as, duration, delay, startOnView, animateOnHover or a custom characterSet; the left-to-right lock order is built in.
weight_why: Short text split into spans; the frame loop only runs during the brief scramble.

a11y.note: The scramble is hover-only so keyboard users cannot trigger it, and split letters can be read one by one by screen readers.

polish_why: Crisp monospace scramble that resolves cleanly and is paced well.
title: Hyper Text
